pages.text: The Tribe keeps one shared memory of provocation. Its visible states are $(bold)Appeased$(), $(bold)Low$(), $(bold)Moderate$(), and $(bold)High$().$(br2)Opening guarded tribute and killing ogres near their camps worsens relations. Defeating hostile patrols and time itself can cool their anger. Hold $(bold)H$() anywhere to inspect the current mood.

pages.title: Buying Peace
pages.text: Every Merchant accepts a Golden Ogre Tooth for an Ogre Truce, reducing the Tribe's anger. It is peace by receipt, not friendship.
